title: Pointed etale ring-colimit presentation of strict henselization
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and barY:Spec Omega -> Spec R a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] with image y. Let H be strictHenselizationRing barY [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] and b:R -> H have spectrum equal to strictHenselizationStructuralMap barY [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. There are a small cofiltered category I, a ring diagram F:I^op -> CommRing, a colimit cocone c [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], a natural family a_j:R -> F(j), and an isomorphism e:c.pt -> H, such that a_j;c.iota_j;e=b for every j. For every j, Spec(a_j) is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and has a point z_j over y [def-weil-affine-spectrum].

source.place: Tags 0BSK (10.155.11, pointed etale colimit), 03Q9 (strict henselization as affine-neighbourhood limit)

proof.text: Use the chosen small representative category, strictHenselizationAffineDiagram and smallStrictHenselizationCocone. isColimitSmallStrictHenselizationCocone proves this cocone colimiting with vertex the adopted strictHenselization. strictHenselizationAffineProperties supplies cofilteredness. Take e to be the identity isomorphism.

For each representative affine pointed neighbourhood define its structure map k to Spec R using GammaSpecIso, and take a=Spec.preimage k. Prove naturality directly by Spec.map_injective, GammaSpecIso_inv_naturality and the over-category triangle equation. The structural-map leg equation strictHenselizationStructuralMap_eq and hb prove the colimit-leg composite is b.

Etaleness follows from the neighbourhood structure and the affine comparison isomorphism. Choose the zero prime of Omega, map it by the lift and the affine comparison, and use the over-category equality and hy to show the resulting point maps to y.

lean.statement:
theorem pointed_etale_ring_colimit
    (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec R)
    (y : Spec R) (hy : ∀ x : Spec (.of Ω), barY x = y)
    (b : R ⟶ strictHenselization barY)
    (hb : Spec.map b = strictLocalizationToBase barY) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (cat : Category.{u} I), letI := cat
      ∃ (_ : IsCofiltered I) (F : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone F)
        (a : (Functor.const Iᵒᵖ).obj R ⟶ F)
        (e : c.pt ≅ strictHenselization barY),
        Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧
        (∀ j, a.app j ≫ c.ι.app j ≫ e.hom = b) ∧
        ∀ j, Etale (Spec.map (a.app j)) ∧
          ∃ z : Spec (F.obj j), (Spec.map (a.app j)) z = y
